units.titles: TOB-HELI-8: Accounting bug in withdraw enables sandwich and flashloan attacks | TOB-HELI-2: Yield distribution is susceptible to front-running
units.known_address_notes: Trail of Bits 'Helios Global Security Assessment' (2024-02-27). Helios Global = RWA platform onboarding investments into solar-energy projects; scope is the regional pools and related contracts (AbstractPool is ERC20+ReentrancyGuard, secondary accounting, unlockedToWithdraw), findings TOB-HELI-2/8 match the corpus titles. Fix commits b5b28ea, 50a7a0a, e894498 referenced but no repo, chain or address is given. No public repo/site or deployed pool located.
